- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "A missing path holds the plan as replannable." (issue item 2; issue title: "never drop an approved plan's extensionless file from its grant")
  Expected change site: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py::_plan_grant_missing_path (line 907) and scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py::_plan_grant_path (lines 882-885)
  Evidence of absence: _plan_grant_missing_path returns "" for any path with fewer than two segments (line 907), and _plan_grant_path returns "" for a root-level extensionless token that is not a regular file in the checkout (lines 882-885). A plan listing a root-level extensionless file absent from the planning checkout (e.g. `Dockerfile`, `VERSION`, `Makefile`) is neither granted nor counted missing, so the gate approves and the file is silently dropped from the grant. Only the nested case is covered by tests (`bin/new`, `scripts/new-tool`, `lib/run`; tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:2213-2218). Both fragments document the narrowing as deliberate (prose-token false-hold risk), and prior editor runs declined it; a middle fix (count a root-level token missing only when the Files bullet presents it as a path) was never attempted.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
